note: the best strategy so far: +$7,486 at profit factor 1.75 on the search window, +$4,074 at 2.25 held out. It takes profit when a laggard's move reaches +0.5 sigma; every iteration here takes it much later.

z15.title: CATCH-UP AT +1.5 SIGMA.
z15.doc: Sells at +1.5 sigma: three times the parent's overshoot.

z2.title: CATCH-UP AT +2 SIGMA.
z2.doc: Sells at +2 sigma: a laggard that becomes the leader.

run_trail.title: CAUGHT UP, THEN TRAIL.
run_trail.doc: Once caught up (+0.5 sigma) it is not sold; it is held until it falls 4 ATR off the last session's high. No ceiling on the take-profit at all.

atr8.title: PRICE TARGET, 8 ATR.
atr8.doc: No catch-up exit. The take-profit is 8 ATR above the entry.

atr12.title: PRICE TARGET, 12 ATR.
atr12.doc: No catch-up exit. The take-profit is 12 ATR above the entry.

tiered.title: HALF AT 4 ATR, HALF AT 10.
tiered.doc: Half the position at 4 ATR above the entry, the rest at 10. The catch-up exit moves to +1 sigma as a backstop.

close_gap_twice.title: CLOSE THE GAP TO THE LEADER, TWICE.
close_gap_twice.doc: The gap is how far this name's last 16 bars trail the basket's best name's. The target is twice that gap above the entry: catch the leader and pass it. No catch-up exit.

range_high.title: BACK TO THE RANGE HIGH.
range_high.doc: A laggard fell from somewhere. The target is the highest high of the last three sessions plus 2 ATR: all the way back, and a little past. No catch-up exit.
range_high.targets:
highs = [float(h) for h in context.highs(symbol, 78)]
    if not highs:
        return []
    return [(max(highs) + 2 * read["atr_pct"] * entry, 0.0)]

vwap_band.title: VWAP PLUS TWO SIGMA.
vwap_band.doc: The three-session volume-weighted price plus two volume-weighted standard deviations: from below the group's fair price to well above it. No catch-up exit.
vwap_band.targets:
closes = [float(c) for c in context.closes(symbol, 78)]
    volumes = [float(v) for v in context.volumes(symbol, 78)]
    total = sum(volumes)
    if len(closes) != len(volumes) or total <= 0:
        return []
    vwap = sum(c * v for c, v in zip(closes, volumes)) / total
    sd = math.sqrt(sum(v * (c - vwap) ** 2 for c, v in zip(closes, volumes)) / total)
    return [(vwap + 2 * sd, 0.0)]
